hebrew.text: בְּרֵאשִׁ֖ית בָּרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֵ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

translation.text: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

addressNote.en: The verse narrates the creation of heaven and earth. It is not a commandment addressed to Israel or to Bnei Noach. Rashi’s first comment, however, explains why Israel’s Torah begins here, which is Israel-covenant context.
addressNote.pt: O versículo narra a criação dos céus e da terra. Não é um mandamento dirigido a Israel ou aos Bnei Noach. O primeiro comentário de Rashi, porém, explica por que a Torá de Israel começa aqui — contexto da aliança de Israel.

hebrew.text: וְהָאָ֗רֶץ הָיְתָ֥ה תֹ֙הוּ֙ וָבֹ֔הוּ וְחֹ֖שֶׁךְ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י תְה֑וֹם וְר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מְרַחֶ֖פֶת עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַמָּֽיִם׃

translation.text: Now the earth was unformed and void, and darkness was upon the face of the deep; and the spirit of God hovered over the face of the waters.

addressNote.en: A description of the earth before formed order. No legal address.
addressNote.pt: Descrição da terra antes da ordem formada. Sem endereço legal.

translation.text: And God said: ‘Let there be light.’ And there was light.

addressNote.en: Divine speech brings light into being. Universal narrative, not a human obligation.
addressNote.pt: A fala divina faz a luz existir. Narrativa universal, não uma obrigação humana.

hebrew.text: וַיַּ֧רְא אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־הָא֖וֹר כִּי־ט֑וֹב וַיַּבְדֵּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֔ים בֵּ֥ין הָא֖וֹר וּבֵ֥ין הַחֹֽשֶׁךְ׃

translation.text: And God saw the light, that it was good; and God divided the light from the darkness.

addressNote.en: God evaluates and separates light from darkness. Cosmic order, not covenantal law.
addressNote.pt: Deus avalia e separa a luz das trevas. Ordem cósmica, não lei da aliança.

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ לָאוֹר֙ י֔וֹם וְלַחֹ֖שֶׁךְ קָ֣רָא לָ֑יְלָה וַֽיְהִי־עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃ (פ)

translation.text: And God called the light Day, and the darkness He called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, one day.

addressNote.en: Naming Day and Night, and the first day’s close. Rashi reads “one day” as pointing to God’s uniqueness before the angels are created.
addressNote.pt: A nomeação de Dia e Noite, e o encerramento do primeiro dia. Rashi lê “um dia” como apontando à unicidade de Deus antes da criação dos anjos.

hebrew.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים יְהִ֥י רָקִ֖יעַ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַמָּ֑יִם וִיהִ֣י מַבְדִּ֔יל בֵּ֥ין מַ֖יִם לָמָֽיִם׃

translation.text: And God said: ‘Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.’

addressNote.en: The command that establishes the firmament. Creation narrative, not a Noahide statute.
addressNote.pt: O comando que estabelece o firmamento. Narrativa da criação, não um estatuto noahide.
